messages:
alex: Heads-up — PR #25711 is blocked, mac-smoke failing on shard-12 consistently after the last rebase. holding merge until we sort this. screenshot + tail of failing test below.

alex: ```
FAIL tests/inference/applet_smoke_test.py::test_applet_startup - AssertionError: expected 200, got 503
  File \"/workspace/.../applet.py\", line 134, in start
  File \"/usr/local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/requests/api.py\"
```

alex: repro attempt locally fails intermittently for me (2/5 runs). appears to correlate with kube node 7 being noisy.

tanya: @alex thanks — can you paste the buildkite link? do we know if this is new after the dependency bump? :eyes:

alex: link: https://buildkite.com/redwood/runtime/builds/4321#d3f2

alex: dependency bump was for httpx 0.24 -> 0.25 in PR, but unit tests for that package passed. smoke is timing out during app bootstrap.

riyad: I can queue a rerun targeting only shard-12 so we don't waste cycles. want me to run targeted job?

alex: please, that'd help. also if rerun fails, I'd like to try a targeted retry with increased logging.

oncall-bot: buildkite: Re-run queued (target: shard-12) by riyad — build #4322 queued. ETA ~4m.

buildkite-bot: buildkite: Build #4322 started on agent-gpu-7.

buildkite-bot: buildkite: Step 'mac-smoke (shard-12)' failed again — same assert 503.

riyad: ok same failure. hypothesis: ephemeral DNS resolution to the app's sidecar is occasionally failing on agent-gpu-7. can someone try a single-run with --force-host=127.0.0.1 to rule out network?

maia: I can try a repro job with host-forced. assigning myself.

maia: queued a debug run with extra network logging (job 4323). patch below I used to enable logs:

maia: ```
ENV DEBUG_NET=1 
pytest tests/inference/applet_smoke_test.py::test_applet_startup -k shard12 --capture=no
```

buildkite-bot: buildkite: Debug job #4323 started on agent-gpu-7.

buildkite-bot: buildkite: Debug job #4323 finished — intermittent DNS lookup timeout seen, stack: 
```
requests.exceptions.ConnectionError: HTTPSConnectionPool(host=\'sidecar.internal\', port=443): Max retries exceeded with url: /health (Caused by NewConnectionError(...))
```

tanya: thanks — that looks like infra (agent networking) rather than app code. @infra-team any recent changes to kube node image or CNI?

alex: pinging infra channel and filing a short ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-811 (brief: flaky DNS on agent-gpu-7 affecting mac-smoke shard-12).

riyad: given this, I'm going to unhold merge and add a temporary bypass: update PR to skip the flaky smoke shard in the merge pipeline until infra fixes the node. needs 1 approval to go in. more permanent fix will be infra remediation + revert.

alex: I'd rather not skip tests long-term, but ok for short window if we clearly annotate. can someone give an approval so I can merge before tomorrow's release window? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maia: lgtm to skip shard-12 for now, please add a follow-up card and revert note in the PR. :white_check_mark:

riyad: @tanya can you approve the PR to unblock? I'm short on cycles today.

oncall-bot: reminder: please ensure any test-skips have a ticket and ETA for revert per policy.

tanya: approved — adding a comment on PR with the ticket link and a revert ETA. go ahead and merge once CI turns green for the rest. :shipit:

alex: merging now. will monitor post-merge telemetry and follow up with infra on RINF-811. thanks all. :raised_hands:

maia: follow-up note: once infra confirms, we should re-run the full mac-smoke matrix against a healthy agent and flip the skip. I'll take the revert card.

alex: noted. tagging @infra-team in the ticket and cc'ing on the revert card.

riyad: thanks — good tradeoff for release safety.

maia: (added) small debug snippet I used in case someone else needs it later:
```
# force host to avoid DNS in local repro
python -m http.server 8080 &
EXPORT SIDECAR_HOST=127.0.0.1
pytest tests/inference/applet_smoke_test.py::test_applet_startup -k shard12 --maxfail=1
```

alex: saved — closing thread after monitoring.
